summary: Raw material for single-origin tests is public (GenBank and BOLD sequences with locality, GBIF occurrence ranges), but no compiled multi-species phylogeographic table was found, and the only range-wide datasets located are single-species deposits; the test would need a purpose-built sample of species with range-wide sequences.
next_step: Choose 20-50 species with range-wide multilocus data (start from BOLD species with many countries), pre-register the monophyly criterion and the species-delimitation filter.
obstacles_confirmed: Range-wide sequences exist for a small fraction of species.
Species boundaries and geographic origins are often uncertain.
Published phylogeographies would have to be compiled, which is months of work at global scope.
